lines.text: Ever wondered how big GTA 6 really is? Because the numbers are straight up insane.
First twenty-four hours: three point seven nine billion dollars. That's the publisher's own estimate.
That's about four and a half times what GTA 5 made on day one.
Roughly forty-four thousand dollars. Every. Single. Second.
And everybody's playing. Kai Cenat started a marathon aiming for a hundred percent completion. IShowSpeed says he's streaming ten hours a day.
Streams Charts reportedly counted almost eight million people watching at once. A launch record, though the numbers are preliminary.
Critics? Ninety-nine on Metacritic. That ties Ocarina of Time for the highest score ever.
The only catch: thirty frames per second on every console.
Recap: billions in a day, streamers everywhere, and a ninety-nine.
Follow for more. Next: why games have loading screens.
